== Format ==
*4on4 - Ladder
*Points per match played, see Points below
*Points for completing challenges

=== Sign up ===
Your clan can either sign up by messaging {{player|'''Hooraytio#3070'''|flag=se|link=false}} on discord, or just agree to play a ladder prac with another clan and report the result in the <mark>#ladder-reports</mark> channel on the qlanwars discord.

== Rules == 
* '''Prac procedure:''' Agree to play a ladder prac with another clan. Team and/or tag must be your clans name or tag. Play as many maps as you like. You get points for every map your clan plays, see "Points" below. Whoever has the most points at the end of the season wins. 

* '''Points:''' For season 6 the points system borrowed from old NQR ladder. 



Each clan starts with 1000 points. 

Example: Clan A: 2000p, Clan B: 1000p.
Game ends 2-1 (500-250). Clan A will receive 167 points and Clan B will receive 133.

The procedure to calculate the distribution of points is as follows:

Rating at stake (RAS) = 100 * (Clan 1 points / Clan 2 points).
For Clan A and B in example 1) this would be 100 * (2000 / 1000) = 200

Expected performance (EP) = Clan 1 points / (Clan 1 points + Clan 2 points).
For Clan A in example 1) this would be 2000 / (2000 + 1000) = 0.67
For Clan B in example 1) this would be 1000 / (2000 + 1000) = 0.33

Actual performance (AP) = Clan 1 score / (Clan 1 score + Clan 2 score).
For Clan A in example 1) this would be 500 / (500 + 250) = 0.67
For Clan B in example 1) this would be 250 / (500 + 250) = 0.33

Points for game score (PGS) = (AP / EP) * (RAS/2)
For Clan A in example 1) this would be (0.67 / 0.67) * (200/2) = 100
For Clan B in example 1) this would be (0.33 / 0.33) * (200/2) = 100

Points for map wins (PMW) = (RAS / 6) * maps won
For Clan A in example 1) this would be (200 / 6) * 2 = 67
For Clan B in example 1) this would be (200 / 6) * 1 = 33

Total points (TP) = PGS + PMW
For Clan A in example 1) this would be 100 + 67 = 167
For Clan B in example 1) this would be 100 + 33 = 133

* '''Challenges:''' Challenge points are awarded to teams based on completed EQL Ladder listed challenges. Claims of completed challenges must be made no later than season end date, with a supporting time stamped screenshot/.mvd uploaded in #eql-spl. New challenge proposals during season are most welcome, but must be listed on the Wiki before date of claim. Unless it's really awesome.  

* '''Challenge cup:''' The clan with the most challenge points at the end of the season wins the Challenge cup

* '''Clans and players:''' A clan can have any number of players. Members will not be listed. If the opponent does not agree with your line-up then find another opponent. You are allowed to create new clans and switch teams during the ladder.

* '''Maps:''' Any map is allowed, it is not up to the admin to decide which maps you want prac on. If the opponent doesnt agree with your pick then play another map or find another opponent.

* '''Stand-ins:''' You can use any standin you want as long as you can find an opponent who wants to play. Max 1 standin per clan to count as a ladder prac.

* '''Prac vs mix:''' Your clan can prac versus a mixed team. The mix teams points will be an average of the clans points at any given date.

* '''Prac vs 2 clans:''' Not possible with the new point system.

* '''Internal Prac:''' Will no longer count as a ladder prac.

* '''Server settings:''' Standard settings set by command /4on4

* '''Reporting:''' Report the game with screenshots in #ladder-reports
